Hi Zoe —

Appreciate the clear ask and the RFP. High-level summary below; Ben (sales engineering) and Marissa (solutions) are looped for the detailed grid and an options table. We can absolutely turn around a 1-page commercial that maps to your procurement timeline.

High-level:
- Licensing: we typically price Private deployments as a subscription per inference node (per node / month) for on-prem, with an option for higher-concurrency SKUs.
- Platform fee: annual, flat fee that covers the control plane, model catalog access, and security integrations. There is flexibility on how we apply a platform fee as credits against committed consumption for multi-year deals.
- Support tiers: Standard / Premium / Enterprise. Enterprise supports 24/7 P1 paging and an assigned Technical Account Manager.
- Migration credits: available for multi-year commitments; we frequently apply a one-time onboarding credit to offset initial services.

Ben and Marissa — can you prepare: (a) a pricing grid (list + typical discount bands), (b) two commercial options (1yr low-commit, 3yr committed with migration credits), and (c) suggested SOW terms for platform fee treatment?

Thanks — I'll coordinate a short call if needed.

Best,

Hi Zoe — following up with a more concrete breakdown based on the ~8 node baseline you provided. Below are ballpark commercial constructs we typically propose (will provide a spreadsheet).

Pricing constructs (list):
- On-prem license: $12,000 / node / month (covers runtime binary, model runtime optimizations, and updates)
- Platform fee (control plane): $50,000 / year base (applies to the account, tiered for larger footprints)
- Support tiers (annual):
  - Standard: included, business hours, 2 business day P1 response
  - Premium: ~12% of annual license spend, 24/7 P1 paging, 4hr initial response
  - Enterprise: ~20% of annual license spend, 24/7 P1 with 60min response, TAM, quarterly on-site (or remote) reviews

Discounting guidance and levers:
- Multi-year (3yr) commits: typical starting discount 12–18% on license list; up to 20% for strategic refs + PO timing
- Volume: >25 nodes we scale platform fee and license bands (additional 5–10% off list)
- Platform fee conversion: for 3yr committed deals we can convert up to 50% of year1 platform fee into consumption credits applied to first-year billing (subject to SOW language)
- Migration/onboarding credit: $30k–$60k, scaled to services scope; typically granted on 2–3yr commits

Negotiation notes: the easiest levers are term length and whether the platform fee is paid upfront vs amortized. If procurement wants a lower upfront cash requirement we can amortize and/or apply credits tied to milestones.

I've attached a CSV with a sample grid and an internal HubSpot deal reference.

-Ben
